# chunk of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:chunkOf`](gmeow-chunkOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/chunkOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The source information object this chunk segments. Functional: a chunk is cut from exactly one source; re-chunking produces new [`Chunk`](../classes/gmeow-Chunk.md) individuals, never a re-pointed one.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Chunk`](../classes/gmeow-Chunk.md) -> [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:chunkOf`](gmeow-chunkOf.md) from [`gmeow:Chunk`](../classes/gmeow-Chunk.md) to [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`gmeow:Chunk`](../classes/gmeow-Chunk.md) to the single source information object it was cut from — the parthood seam that makes 'where in the source?' answerable.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing one chunk at two sources (it is functional — a different cut is a new [`Chunk`](../classes/gmeow-Chunk.md)) and avoid using it for the chunk's evidence pin (that is [`gmeow:spanOfChunk`](gmeow-spanOfChunk.md), span-into-chunk, not chunk-into-source).

### How to use

- Assert exactly one [`gmeow:chunkOf`](gmeow-chunkOf.md) per [`Chunk`](../classes/gmeow-Chunk.md); it specializes [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md), so generic part/whole consumers read the segmentation by inheritance while gmeow:spanStart/spanEnd carry the exact offsets.
